key_path: Register at business.phonepe.com/pg/register with mobile number + OTP
Enter business details: PAN, business type, GSTIN (if applicable), bank account, website/app URL
Open PhonePe Business Dashboard > Developer Settings and copy the Client ID + Client Secret (+ client_version)

POST client credentials to the token endpoint: UAT https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/v1/oauth/token, prod https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/v1/oauth/token. This returns an O-Bearer access_token with expires_at and must be refreshed
Test in the UAT sandbox using templates, test cards and mock OTP 123456
Go-live: KYC documents reviewed + website compliance check by PhonePe before production transactions
human_gates_notes: PhonePe is an RBI-licensed Payment Aggregator, so merchant KYC/due diligence is mandatory for production. The docs do not clearly say whether UAT credentials are self-serve without KYC. The authorization page says keys come from Developer Settings on the dashboard.

agent_native_auth.sandbox_test_credentials: yes. UAT sandbox host api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox with configurable success/failure/pending templates, test cards, PhonePe Test App (iOS test app requires emailing the integration team)
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes in the sense that there is no signup fee; pricing is per transaction (MDR)

mcp.notes: No official PhonePe MCP found as of 2026-10-11. Only community servers (e.g. glama.ai listings, an 'India Payments MCP' that routes through Razorpay). Competitors Razorpay and Cashfree have shipped official MCPs.

docs_for_agents.openapi: no public OpenAPI found. Backend SDKs exist for Java, Python, Node and PHP

score_justification: The OAuth client-credentials API and a decent sandbox are usable, but there is no MCP, llms.txt or OpenAPI, and signup is phone-OTP plus business KYC gated.
best_practice: A sandbox with configurable response templates (success/failure/pending) lets an agent test every payment branch deterministically
biggest_gap: No agent surface at all: no MCP, no machine-readable docs, and an unclear path to test credentials without a KYC'd merchant account
